_readme: Everything the resume builder is allowed to say about you. Nothing outside this file (and meta/inbox/) is ever used, and nothing in it is ever embellished. Keys starting with _ are hints: delete them or leave them, they are ignored. Anything that doesn't fit a field goes in 'facts' as a question and answer.

_hints.experience: One entry per employer, most recent first; copy _example_experience. Dates are YYYY-MM or 'present'. title_history = earlier titles at the same company. In achievements, put numbers in 'metrics' only if they are real. Anything under 'private' (why joined / why left) is never put on a resume; it's for interview prep.
_hints.skills: Only things you would be comfortable being interviewed on.
_hints.facts: Free-form Q&A for anything that doesn't fit elsewhere: awards, gaps, visa status, side work, mentoring, context behind a role. Answers to JD gap questions land here too.
_hints.declined: Keywords you said you do NOT have: {term, date}. The skill won't ask about them again.
_hints.preferences: rules: your own writing rules, applied on top of the built-in ones. region: e.g. IN, US, EU (drives photo/DOB/address conventions). max_pages: null = auto. section_order: e.g. ["summary","experience","skills","projects","education"]. filename_stem: e.g. Jane-Doe-Resume.
_hints.last_updated: Set automatically (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever the skill changes this file. If it's older than preferences.stale_after_days (default 30), the skill runs a quick check-in before building a resume. stale_snoozed_until is set when you skip that check-in.
_hints.deep_dive: Say '/create-resume deep dive' to be interviewed role by role. The more detail here (why, how, numbers, what was hard), the better every tailored resume gets. Worth repeating every few months.

_example_experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
_example_experience.team: What the team did, its size, who you reported to

achievements.text: Moved nightly reporting from cron scripts to an SQS worker pool
achievements.how: Split jobs per tenant, added idempotency keys, retried with backoff
achievements.why: Nightly cron reports took 6h and often missed the 9am deadline
achievements.need: Finance ops needed reports before the morning close
achievements.constraints: No new infra budget; had to reuse SQS

ownership.my_part: Design and the worker pool; a teammate built the retry dashboard

outcomes: Became the pattern for all batch jobs
challenges: Duplicate reports on retries, fixed with idempotency keys
learnings: Design for retries from day one

private.why_joined: Wanted to own backend systems end to end
private.why_left: Team was restructured; looking for larger scale

_example_fact.q: Did you win any awards or hackathons?
